name: Michael Chen
summary: Strategic finance executive with 12+ years of experience in financial planning, analysis, and corporate strategy. Proven track record of driving profitable growth, optimizing capital structure, and leading cross-functional teams through acquisitions, fundraising, and operational transformations for both public and private companies.

education.degree: Master of Business Administration (MBA), Finance Concentration

points: Lead finance function for $500M revenue SaaS company, managing team of 15 across FP&A, accounting, tax, and treasury
Drove EBITDA margin improvement from 18% to 28% through pricing optimization, cost reduction initiatives, and operational efficiency programs
Led Series D fundraising process, securing $85M in growth capital with participation from top-tier venture firms at 35% valuation increase
Built comprehensive financial planning infrastructure including 3-statement models, departmental budgets, and KPI dashboards used by executive team for strategic decisions
Managed two strategic acquisitions totaling $120M, conducting due diligence, negotiating deal terms, and leading post-merger integration
Managed financial planning and analysis for $2.3B asset management firm with 200+ employees
Improved forecast accuracy from 82% to 96% by implementing rolling forecasts and driver-based planning models
Identified $8M in annual cost savings opportunities through vendor consolidation and process automation initiatives
Led quarterly board presentations and earnings preparation, communicating financial results and strategic recommendations to board members and investors
Led audit engagements for public and private companies ranging from $100M to $5B in revenue across technology, retail, and manufacturing sectors
Managed teams of 5-8 staff accountants, providing mentorship and conducting performance reviews
Identified and communicated internal control deficiencies and recommended process improvements to CFOs and audit committees
Specialized in revenue recognition under ASC 606 and complex financial instruments valuation
Executed M&A transactions and capital raises totaling $3.2B across technology and healthcare sectors
Built detailed financial models including DCF, LBO, and merger consequences analyses for client presentations
Conducted industry research and competitive analysis to support strategic advisory services
Prepared pitch books, management presentations, and Board materials for C-level executives

projects.title: IPO Readiness Initiative
projects.description: Led cross-functional effort to prepare company for public markets, implementing SOX controls, establishing audit committee, and building investor relations infrastructure. Successfully achieved SOX compliance 6 months ahead of target timeline.
projects.tech: Project Management, SOX Compliance, Process Documentation

projects.title: ERP System Implementation
projects.description: Project lead for $2.5M Oracle Financials implementation affecting 150+ finance users. Designed chart of accounts, configured financial reporting, and managed data migration from legacy systems with 99.8% accuracy.
projects.tech: System Implementation, Change Management, Cross-functional Leadership

awards: CFO of the Year Finalist, San Francisco Business Times (2023)
